description: This Java interface defines a builder for creating responses and events related to the DeleteFeatureProperty command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods for constructing success responses, error responses indicating accessibility or modifiability issues, and triggering feature property deletion events.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface to build responses and events for DeleteFeatureProperty commands.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface to create success and error responses for DeleteFeatureProperty commands.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface to produce deletion events for feature properties.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Creates a response indicating successful deletion of the feature property.

methods.name: featurePropertyNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the feature property was not accessible.

methods.name: featurePropertyNotModifiableError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the feature property was not modifiable.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Creates a FeaturePropertyDeleted event reflecting the deletion.
